title: Chapter 607 - 607 Destroyed; Envy!
content:
Chapter 607 - 607 Destroyed; Envy!

Chapter 607 - 607 Destroyed; Envy!

607 Destroyed; Envy!

Lin Fan’s voice was not loud.

However, it was like the voice of a god, ethereal and vast.

It rippled through the entire forest.

In the next moment, the countless fire swords that were hovering in the air shot out in all directions.

Wherever the fire sword passed by, the tree trunks and branches broke and burned rapidly, turning into ashes in an instant.

No!

Not only were the trees attacked, but many bronze-armored warriors and all kinds of ferocious beasts in the forbidden area were also attacked and turned into ashes.

As for those that were wrapped in branches, those who were chased by branches, and those who were entangled by branches… all of them landed on the ground safely.

They looked at the flaming longswords flying in front of them and were stunned.

A moment later, the fire swords disappeared and the trees dissipated.

The entire forbidden area became bare. There were no longer any trees, only flying smoke and dust.

At this moment, a series of emotionless voices rang out in Lin Fan’s ears.

[The first to kill a level-six Black Python. You’ve obtained a level-five treasure chest.]

[The first to kill a level-six Black Python. Hua Nation’s air quality has increased by 10%.]

[The first to kill a level-seven Tigerhawk. You’ve obtained a level-six treasure chest.]

[The first to kill a level-seven Tigerhawk. Hua Nation’s pollution has reduced by 10%.]

[The first to kill a level-eight Iron Lion. You’ve obtained a level-seven treasure chest.]

[The first to kill a level-eight Iron Lion. Hua Nation’s greenery has increased by 10%.]

…

[The first to destroy a level-eight forbidden area. You’ve obtained a level-eight treasure chest.]

[The first to destroy a level-eight forbidden area. A forbidden area has descended Hua Nation.]

In the next moment…

Lin Fan, the Heavenly Hound, Sam, and all the other heroes who were still in a daze disappeared from the level-eight forbidden area.

Then, they returned to the location where they had opened the 30-day golden treasure chest.

In front of Lin Fan, a few treasure chests appeared.

Lin Fan did not hesitate as he opened the chests one by one.

[300 Constitution points. Do you want to use them?]

[200 points of spiritual energy. Do you want to use them?]

[400 Constitution points. Do you want to use them?]

…

At the same time, Lin Fan’s mind was filled with the crisp sound of notifications.

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a special red packet—3,000 Constitution points.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a special red packet—2,000 points of spiritual energy.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a special red packet—4,000 Constitution points.]

…

His strength and spiritual energy were both growing rapidly.

Lin Fan felt extremely carefree.

Finally, he turned his attention to the mysterious treasure chest.

[You’ve obtained Beginner Wood Controlling Technique. Do you want to use it?]

A clear notification sounded in his mind again.

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a special red packet—Advanced Wood Controlling Technique.]

Instantly, within Lin Fan’s vision, the ground, rocks, and various other places were all filled with dense wood attribute particles.

Lin Fan had a very vivid feeling that as long as he willed it, these wood attribute particles would quickly gather together and grow into a lush green field of grass and towering trees.

Incredibly marvelous!

Lin Fan’s lips curled up. Clearly, he was in a good mood.

Then, he said to the Heavenly Hound, “Use these things.”

The Heavenly Hound called out softly.

It wagged its tail and touched the balls of light with its claws.

As the orbs of light entered the Heavenly Hound’s body, its aura became even more tyrannical.

Lin Fan looked at the bird in his hand and said, “Go and get some firewood.”

When the Heavenly Hound and Sam heard this, they hurriedly brought over a large pile of firewood.

The fire was lit after the seasonings were applied to the meat.

Soon, a fragrance filled the air.

…

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

Xiao Bing praised sincerely, “He’s so powerful!”

Protect the World Flame: [This is the power of martial arts! There were so many swords!]

Love You: [Such a large group of tree demons was actually killed in an instant.]

Other People’s Children: [Too awesome!]

Green Grassland: [God Lin, you still say that you’re not a god?]

Donut: The Heavenly Hound has gotten so many good things at once. It’s another day of envying a dog.]

Hello: [Another day of envying a dog.]

Born Human: [Another day of envying a dog.]

Coming is City Man: [Another day of envying a dog.]

…

The entire screen was soon filled with comments about people envying the Heavenly Hound.

Shadowless: [There seemed to be some special discoveries in the forbidden area that descended in Hua Nation last time. Now, another forbidden area has appeared again. Does anyone know where it appeared?]

Comparing: [F*ck! A large forest suddenly appeared in the center of Quan City. Moreover, it’s the same forest as the level-eight forbidden area!]

Stay Aloof From the World: [A big tree suddenly appeared in my house and scared me!]

Wan: [Oh my God… So many trees! However, the air smells good and refreshing! Heavens! My shortsightedness seems to be gone!]

Shanchuan: [Me too, I’m suddenly not short-sighted anymore!]

Sun: [Is the forbidden area that powerful? I’ve been nearsighted for many years. I’m going to Quan City now!]

Blockhead: [I’ll go too!]

…

Many people set off for Quan City.

Some people wanted to be treated for shortsightedness like the people in Quan City.

Some people wanted to see if they could treat other illnesses.

After all, if one could recover from vision-related ailments, one might be able to recover from other illnesses as well.

There were also some people who were curious.

However, when these people arrived at Quan City, they were stopped by a large group of investigators and soldiers.

From now on, Quan City would be strictly managed.

…

In Nashland’s live broadcast room.

The host jumped up excitedly and shouted, “Oh my god! What did I just see? A bunch of flaming longswords flew over from the sky? They burned down all the trees!

“I know, God must have saved them!”

Jack: [The heroes are fine. That’s great!]

Fred: [Just now… What exactly happened?]

Galen: [Amazing!]

Abbott: [The flaming longswords remind me of a mage.]

Job: [It’s Lin Fan. It’s Hua Nation’s Lin Fan. He’s the man who’s called a god! He shot out countless flaming swords and destroyed the entire level-eight forbidden area. It’s simply unbelievable.]

Forrest: [Lin Fan has the power of a god!]

Ebota: [Lin Fan has killed so many monsters. Hua Nation’s energy, greenery, air quality, and human lifespan… All of them has increased and improved! I heard that the air in Hua Nation is filled with a sweet smell!]

Klaus: [Is it too late to join Hua Nation now?]

This sentence seemed to resonate with many people.

Therefore, on that day, many people came to Hua Nation to become Hua citizens.

Unfortunately, they were destined to make a wasted trip.

That was because the Hua household registration was not something that could be obtained just because one wanted to.
